CustomField.description: Formula: RDD__c + Contract_Term_Months__c months. Inherited by Contract.Service_End_Date__c on contract creation.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(RDD__c), NULL, DATE( YEAR(RDD__c) + FLOOR((MONTH(RDD__c) + Contract_Term_Months__c - 1) / 12), MOD(MONTH(RDD__c) + Contract_Term_Months__c - 1, 12) + 1, IF(DAY(RDD__c) > 28, 28, DAY(RDD__c)) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculated service expiry date: RDD + Contract Term months. Drives the T-90 renewal trigger and is inherited by the linked Contract. Blank when RDD is not set.
CustomField.label: Service End Date
